skill.frost_nova.desc: Slow zombies in a large radius.
skill.meteor_strike.desc: Call a meteor at your aim point—warning ring, then fiery impact.
skill.celestial_beam.desc: Unleash rotating holy beams that sweep through enemies.
skill.void_rift.desc: Open a shadow vortex that pulls foes in, then bursts.
skill.phoenix_flame.desc: Blast a wave of fire outward, burning and knocking back foes.

skill.thunderstorm.desc: Strike multiple enemies with chained lightning.
skill.arcane_vortex.desc: Launch homing missiles at every foe in range.
skill.forked_lightning.desc: Unleash jittering forked lightning that bounces between foes.
skill.electro_arc.desc: Draw a fractal arc tree to your aim—foes along the path take shock damage.
skill.super_nova.desc: Detonate expanding rings of explosions outward from you.
skill.smoke_veil.desc: Blanket the area in smoke; enemies inside are slowed.
skill.death_spiral.desc: Spin a bouncing laser around you for about one second.
skill.plasma_field.desc: Unleash a spreading plasma field; chained arcs shock foes inside.

skill.healing_mist.desc: Release restorative mist that heals nearby allies.
skill.gravity_well.desc: Place a white hole at your aim—it pulls hostiles for 2.5s, then detonates.
skill.scatter_blast.desc: Fire three grenades in a fan; they bounce once and explode on hit or ground.
skill.detonation_beam.desc: Fire an explosive laser to your aim—detonates at the endpoint with a brief pull.
skill.homing_plasma.desc: Launch plasma that locks the nearest foe, accelerates tracking, and explodes on impact.
skill.ricochet_shot.desc: Fire a fast bouncing bullet that ricochets off walls up to 3 times and damages hostiles on hit.
skill.laser_trap.desc: Deploy a laser fence toward your aim—hostiles crossing it take repeated damage for 15 seconds.
skill.bomb_sentinel.desc: Place a magic core at your feet that auto-fires powerful bombs at the nearest hostile in range.
skill.acid_pool.desc: Place a toxic slime pool that poisons and slows hostiles standing inside.
skill.corpse_burst.desc: Detonate a rotting shockwave around you, dealing heavy damage and briefly slowing hostiles.
skill.smoke_hook.desc: Fire a smoker hook toward the nearest hostile in your aim—pull them closer and inflict poison burn.
skill.web_snare.desc: Snare the nearest hostile in your aim with sticky web, nearly immobilizing them.

npc.dream_keeper.greeting.0: Flower: This library holds ancient legends. You're welcome to browse.
npc.dream_keeper.story.1: Flower: What's in your pocket... is a Celestial's relic.
npc.dream_keeper.story.2: Flower: Long ago, a powerful mage cast a curse upon all Celestials.
npc.dream_keeper.story.3: Flower: They can never obtain what they desire most.
npc.dream_keeper.story.4: Flower: You know the owner of that pistol, don't you?
npc.dream_keeper.story.5: Flower: Her name has been erased from the world... That's part of the curse.
npc.dream_keeper.story.6: Flower: If you want to save her, seek information in the Capital. But getting in isn't easy—
npc.dream_keeper.story.7: Flower: You must be a noble, join the TeeFun organization, or have sufficient rank.
npc.dream_keeper.followup.1: Flower: Keep raising your rank — the Capital won't welcome a nobody.
npc.quest_master.greeting.0: Quest Master: Need a hand? I've got plenty of contracts here.
npc.shopkeeper.greeting.0: Shopkeeper: Welcome! Take a look at whatever catches your eye.
npc.healer.low_rep.0: Guard: Halt—go train some more and come back, kid.
npc.healer.high_rep.0: Guard: Oh? You've earned it. The road to the Capital is that way.
npc.healer.high_rep.1: Guard: Prepare well — what lies ahead is no joke.
npc.trainer.greeting.0: Trainer: Want to get stronger? Complete some quests and gain experience first.
npc.trainer.intermediate.0: Trainer: Not bad, you've got some skill!
npc.trainer.intermediate.1: Trainer: Keep improving — challenges still await ahead.
npc.trainer.advanced.0: Trainer: Impressive! You've surpassed what I can teach.
npc.trainer.advanced.1: Trainer: Go explore the wider world.
npc.trainer.training.0: Trainer: Practice on the training dummies in the yard above the library.
npc.blacksmith.craft_menu.0: Blacksmith: Need some equipment? Let's see what you need.
npc.tea_house.welcome.1: Tea House Owner: Welcome, traveler! Have a seat.
npc.tea_house.welcome.2: Tea House Owner: This is a place to rest your weary feet.
npc.tea_house.welcome.3: Tea House Owner: I've heard many tales from passing adventurers...
npc.tea_house.welcome.4: Tea House Owner: They say a Celestial once visited this town.
npc.tea_house.welcome.5: Tea House Owner: But her name... strange, I can't quite recall it.
npc.tea_house.welcome.6: Tea House Owner: Anyway, enjoy your stay. Tea is always warm here.
npc.tea_house.rumors.1: Tea House Owner: There's a strange old library in town center.
npc.tea_house.rumors.2: Tea House Owner: The librarian there knows more than she lets on.
npc.tea_house.rumors.3: Tea House Owner: Also, I heard the mine entrance shifted recently.
npc.tea_house.rumors.4: Tea House Owner: Something underground woke up, some say.
npc.tea_house.rumors.5: Tea House Owner: If you're looking for work, the Quest Board has plenty.
npc.training_dummy.hit_me.0: Training Dummy: *creaks* Hit me with your hammer to practice!
